sourceRefs.locator: Ayer MS 1515, volume 1. Summary identifies Ximénez as parish priest in Santo Tomás Chichicastenango; final 56 leaves contain the K’iche’ text and his Spanish translation. Catalogue suggests c. 1700–1703.

What is the Popol Vuh? Identifies the work as K’iche’, possible sixteenth-century exemplar in Latin characters, two-column translation. The research guide gives the wider transcription window 1700–1715.
Passage on the creation of humanity from yellow and white maize ground by Xmucane, notes 470–475.
Project statement, second and final paragraphs: K’iche’, Spanish and English interface and collaboration with the Guatemalan Academy of Mayan Languages.
What is the Popol Vuh? identifies Chichicastenango, Guatemala. The map gives the modern town centre as an orientation.
